planets.name: Kepler-96 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-96 with a 16.2-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-96 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-96. Its orbit and size follow Marcy et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
